verdicts.reason: The two are nearly the same layout. In both, the SHOP SOLSTICE CTA is larger than the Glow. headline, so the hierarchy is inverted. The CTA is jammed against the right edge and touches the decorative circle in the top-right corner. The logo floats on its own near the bottom edge, and the phone runs almost edge to edge vertically. A keeps the logo closer to the phone and leaves less dead space on the left, while B pushes the phone right and leaves a wider empty strip on the left.

These are essentially the same. Both have the oversized CTA crowding the right edge and the corner circle, with the CTA outweighing the headline. Both also have a logo left on its own near the bottom edge between the phone and Glow. B only shifts the phone and logo a little to the left, and that changes nothing that matters.

A reverses the reading order: the CTA comes first, then the headline, then the phone. Its oversized CTA is jammed against the left edge, and the logo collides with the last letter of SOLSTICE. B is just the original portrait layout shrunk into the middle of the banner. Its CTA and logo are tiny and unreadable, and about 90% of the canvas is dead space, so it is unusable.

A is the original shrunk to a tiny column in the middle of the banner. The headline and CTA are illegible and the canvas is almost empty. B is a real horizontal rearrangement, but its CTA overpowers the headline and is cramped against the right edge and the corner circle, and the logo is stranded near the bottom edge.
